paragraphs.speaker: Timothy Lowenhaupt
paragraphs.text: Good night! See you all tomorrow. We still have some more things, but this is the end of Class One. What we're going to do now is celebrate — celebrate all the people who finished Course 7. Can we get some good music, Brian? We're going to hand out certificates, because that's so much more fun than getting a PDF online. So we're going to read each name and hand them out one by one.
